name: Fedelm, seer of Cruachan

attributes.attribute: listed on page 181 of the index

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The index of the encyclopedia lists Fedelm, seer of Cruachan. The row points to page 181. The same page holds the other Fedelm entries. Her sisters carry the names princess of Connacht, of Munster, and the Nine-Times Beautiful. The seer of Cruachan opens this group in the F section.
